FixtureType.name: 1940B Bee Eye LED Moving Head Wash

InfoItems.Info: Converted GDTF to grandMA2 fixture type with Share Converter version 1.4.1
New fixture type based on 19x40W Big Bee Eye LED Moving Head Wash from Beyond Lighting

With 19x40W(RGBW / 4-IN-1) LEDs, variable motorized zoom (3.5 – 50 degrees), and individual pixel control, capable of creating a kaleidoscope effect. It not only has a beam zoom wash visual effect but also has built-in various macro function effects.
